children.name: page-platform-p-0
children.content: Create Awesome Products The Platform The Path to Production How it Works Turn Great Ideas into Awesome Products The Carbon platform allows for product differentiation and the opportunity to increase performance, introduce customization, and get to market faster than with traditional methods of manufacturing. Carbon unites groundbreaking technology with world-class expertise – helping companies transform new ideas into reality.

children.name: page-platform-p-1
children.content: Carbon’s industrial hardware, innovative software, and engineering-grade materials are designed to work together to help our customers design and produce breakthrough products on our platform. Our engineers work on interdepartmental teams, creating feedback loops that continuously advance our technology for the benefit of our customers.

children.name: page-platform-p-2
children.content: What’s more, when you work with Carbon’s technology, you also benefit from access to an ecosystem of specialists who work to help you create the best possible 3D design for the reliable production of a quality product.

children.name: page-platform-p-3
children.content: During discovery, Carbon can assess and optimize your design files for printability or connect you with one of our production partners to get started right away. We can support your product development cycle by working on design iterations and prototypes for validation.

children.name: page-platform-p-4
children.content: In the production phase, we align on goals including cost and timeline. From there, you can get into production with a member of our CPN network, which includes experts in ramping applications to production with the Carbon platform, or we can help you validate your own printer for production.

children.name: page-m3-printer-subtitle

children.name: page-m3-printer-panel-title
children.content: Meet The All New M3 & M3 Max

children.name: page-m3-printer-p-0
children.content: Expanding the space of what’s possible with a simplified print experience, making it easier than ever to get started printing the parts you want to make with the Digital Light Synthesis™ technology process. The evolution of DLS represents a new baseline for innovation and part quality.

children.name: page-m3-printer-p-1
children.content: Next-gen oxygen permeable optics, closed loop control of force and temperature, built-in IR-based resin heating means it has never been easier to get started printing the parts you want to make with DLS technology. The next generation of DLS creates substantially lower forces on the part and introduces closed loop control of force and temperature, opening more possible part orientations and reducing print failures.

children.name: page-m3-printer-p-2
children.content: Lower forces during printing and closed loop control of force and temperature unlock more geometries, especially for elastomeric parts, or parts with features most sensitive to high forces. Plus infrared resin heating is now a core part of the printing platform, allowing you to print with all Carbon’s engineering grade resins by default.

children.name: page-m3-printer-p-3
children.content: Thanks to better heat management, the next generation of DLS printers delivers more throughput per square foot in thermally limited scenarios with throughput improvements for dental models up to 2.5x faster than the M2 printer. †

children.name: page-m3-printer-p-4
children.content: The next-gen of DLS printing improves print consistency across the build platform, reducing the variation in parts across a single-build (cross-build variation) by 30% and producing a premium surface finish you can see and feel.

children.content: Simpler: Built with You in Mind

children.name: page-ao-backpack-p-0
children.content: Unlock around-the-clock production with the AO Backpack for M3. Run continuous print cycles with automatic part removal, unused resin capture, resin refill, and part collection with minimal downtime between cycles.

children.name: page-ao-backpack-p-1
children.content: This is awesome! A reliable, consistent game changer. Ed Peay CAD/CAM Manager, Utah Valley Dental Lab

children.name: page-ao-backpack-p-2
children.content: Say goodbye to the hammer you’ve been using to separate parts from the build plate. The automatic separation blade uses incremental tolerances to consistently separate parts from the build plate between every print.

children.name: page-ao-backpack-p-3
children.content: Collect parts from multiple prints automatically, printing up to 12 hours and collecting upwards of 230 parts, depending on design and geometry. Wake up to a batch of ready-to-go parts and keep production flowing effortlessly as the Backpack starts the next job.

children.name: page-ao-backpack-p-4
children.content: The AO Backpack’s parts collection basket is engineered to capture unused resin from recently printed parts. Its proven design allows for the reclamation of resin by draining it away from the printed parts, leading to a more cost-effective and sustainable production process.

children.content: Create Awesome Products The Platform The Path to Production How it Works Turn Great Ideas into Awesome Products The Carbon platform allows for product differentiation and the opportunity to increase performance, introduce customization, and get to market faster than with traditional methods of manufacturing. Carbon unites groundbreaking technology with world-class expertise – helping companies transform new ideas into reality.

children.name: page-platform-p-1
children.content: Carbon’s industrial hardware, innovative software, and engineering-grade materials are designed to work together to help our customers design and produce breakthrough products on our platform. Our engineers work on interdepartmental teams, creating feedback loops that continuously advance our technology for the benefit of our customers.

children.name: page-platform-p-2
children.content: What’s more, when you work with Carbon’s technology, you also benefit from access to an ecosystem of specialists who work to help you create the best possible 3D design for the reliable production of a quality product.

children.name: page-platform-p-3
children.content: During discovery, Carbon can assess and optimize your design files for printability or connect you with one of our production partners to get started right away. We can support your product development cycle by working on design iterations and prototypes for validation.

children.name: page-platform-p-4
children.content: In the production phase, we align on goals including cost and timeline. From there, you can get into production with a member of our CPN network, which includes experts in ramping applications to production with the Carbon platform, or we can help you validate your own printer for production.

children.content: Meet The All New M3 & M3 Max

children.name: page-m3-printer-subtitle
children.content: A Boon for Creativity, Productivity, and Efficiency

children.name: page-m3-printer-panel-title
children.content: Meet The All New M3 & M3 Max

children.name: page-m3-printer-p-0
children.content: Expanding the space of what’s possible with a simplified print experience, making it easier than ever to get started printing the parts you want to make with the Digital Light Synthesis™ technology process. The evolution of DLS represents a new baseline for innovation and part quality.

children.name: page-m3-printer-p-1
children.content: Next-gen oxygen permeable optics, closed loop control of force and temperature, built-in IR-based resin heating means it has never been easier to get started printing the parts you want to make with DLS technology. The next generation of DLS creates substantially lower forces on the part and introduces closed loop control of force and temperature, opening more possible part orientations and reducing print failures.

children.name: page-m3-printer-p-2
children.content: Lower forces during printing and closed loop control of force and temperature unlock more geometries, especially for elastomeric parts, or parts with features most sensitive to high forces. Plus infrared resin heating is now a core part of the printing platform, allowing you to print with all Carbon’s engineering grade resins by default.

children.name: page-m3-printer-p-3
children.content: Thanks to better heat management, the next generation of DLS printers delivers more throughput per square foot in thermally limited scenarios with throughput improvements for dental models up to 2.5x faster than the M2 printer. †

children.name: page-m3-printer-p-4
children.content: The next-gen of DLS printing improves print consistency across the build platform, reducing the variation in parts across a single-build (cross-build variation) by 30% and producing a premium surface finish you can see and feel.

children.name: page-ao-backpack-p-0
children.content: Unlock around-the-clock production with the AO Backpack for M3. Run continuous print cycles with automatic part removal, unused resin capture, resin refill, and part collection with minimal downtime between cycles.

children.name: page-ao-backpack-p-1
children.content: This is awesome! A reliable, consistent game changer. Ed Peay CAD/CAM Manager, Utah Valley Dental Lab

children.name: page-ao-backpack-p-2
children.content: Say goodbye to the hammer you’ve been using to separate parts from the build plate. The automatic separation blade uses incremental tolerances to consistently separate parts from the build plate between every print.

children.name: page-ao-backpack-p-3
children.content: Collect parts from multiple prints automatically, printing up to 12 hours and collecting upwards of 230 parts, depending on design and geometry. Wake up to a batch of ready-to-go parts and keep production flowing effortlessly as the Backpack starts the next job.

children.name: page-ao-backpack-p-4
children.content: The AO Backpack’s parts collection basket is engineered to capture unused resin from recently printed parts. Its proven design allows for the reclamation of resin by draining it away from the printed parts, leading to a more cost-effective and sustainable production process.
